in_hebrew.name: זלוטה
in_hebrew.meaning: הוא שהיה קנאי לאלוקים או שוחרר
in_hebrew.long_meaning: זלוטה הוא שם שמקורו ביוונית ומשמעותו 'קנאי' או 'שוחרר'. השם נגזר מהמילה היוונית 'Ζηλωτής' (Zēlōtēs), שפירושה 'קנאי' או 'נלהב'. בהקשר המקראי, השם זלוטה מתייחס לאחד מתלמידי ישו, המכונה 'זלוטס' או 'קנאי', שהיה חבר בכת הקנאים או שהיה נלהב לדת היהודית.

in_greek.name: Ζηλωτής
in_greek.long_meaning: Ζηλωτής (Zēlōtēs) σημαίνει 'κζηλωτής' ἢ 'ποθῶν'. Ὁ Ζηλωτής ἦν ἕνας τῶν μαθητῶν τοῦ Ιησου Χριστοῦ, γνωστός ως 'Ζηλωτός' ἢ 'Κζηλωτής', ὁ ὁποῖος ἦν μέλος τῆς Κόμματος τῶν Ζηλωτῶν ἢ ἦν θερμός τῆς θρησκείας τῶν Εβραίων.

in_latin.name: Zelotes
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Zelotes derivatur ex Graeco 'Ζηλωτής' (Zēlōtēs), quod significat 'zelator' vel 'fervens'. In ecclesia primitiva, Zelotes fuit unus ex discipulis Iesu Christi, notus ut 'Zelotes' vel 'zelator', qui fuit membrum factionis Zelotorum vel fuit fervens in religione Iudaica.

in_english.name: Zelote
in_english.long_meaning: The name Zelote originates from the Greek 'Ζηλωτής' (Zēlōtēs), meaning 'zealous one' or 'enthusiast'. In the Christian tradition, Zelote refers to one of Jesus Christ's twelve apostles, known as 'Zelotes' or 'the Zealot', who was a member of the Zealot party or was fervent in his Jewish faith. The name symbolizes zeal, enthusiasm, and devotion to God. Historically, the name Zelote has been used in various Christian cultures, reflecting the importance of spiritual fervor and dedication.

biblical_reference.note: One of Jesus' twelve apostles, also known as 'the Zealot'.

data.cultural_impact: The name Zelote holds cultural significance as it is associated with the ancient Jewish Zealots, who were a influential and revolutionary political and religious movement during the Second Temple Period. Members of this movement advocated for the liberation of Jewish people from Roman oppression through violent resistance. The Zelotes played an important role in the New Testament, as several of Jesus' closest disciples, including Simon, Judas, and Judas Iscariot, were believed to be members of this group. The name Zelote therefore represents a deep commitment to spiritual and national causes, and a willingness to take bold action in pursuit of those beliefs.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Zelote holds spiritual significance as it represents a deep and fervent dedication to one's beliefs, values, and causes. Just as the ancient Jewish Zealots were fiercely devoted to their Jewish nationalist beliefs, the name Zelote can be a reminder to live our lives with equal passion and conviction in our own spiritual pursuits. It is a reminder to be earnest and zealous in our commitment to our faith, and to be willing to take bold action in pursuit of the divine.

historical_references.reference: Zelotes were a sect of Jewish zealots who sought to overthrow the Roman occupation of Judea in the 1st century BC.
